messages:
Sam: heads-up: seeing eu1 GPU pool spike — ~120 GPUs stuck in AllocPending after the firmware push last night. OOB shows repeated eth1 link flaps and IPMI heartbeat drops. Anyone else?
InfraBot: deploy-bot: Firmware rollout "bmc-fix-2026-03-19" completed on eu1 at 2026-03-19T03:12Z. No auto-rollbacks triggered.
Dmitri: yep. I see AllocPending → jobs piling. BMC syslog: "link negotiation timeout" for eth1, falling back to 100Mbps. Suspect MTU or switch auto-neg issue.
Anya: can we force BMC to prefer eth0 for mgmt until we patch? quick mitigation?
Dmitri: short-term: bring eth1 down via IPMI on affected racks, wfm. Example:
```
for R in $(cat affected-racks.txt); do
  ipmitool -I lanplus -H $R -U admin -P **** raw 0x00 0x00 0x00  # pseudo placeholder
done
```
or on-host:
```
ip link set dev eth1 down
```
Priya: cost note: queued workloads burning GPU time. We're losing ~3.2 GPU-hours/minute across the pool. If we migrate jobs to other regions egress + preemption costs spike.
Sam: good catch. Dmitri, can you run the ipmitool down on a canary set (8 racks)? Also pause eu1 autoscaler to avoid churn.
Dmitri: doing canary now. Will soft-reset BMC after link down. ETA 15m. I'll post updates.
Anya: :thumbsup: if canary recovers, we can roll the script wider. If not, fallback = rollback to prior BMC image. Who holds rollback creds?
Priya: I have rollback creds but 2FA needed. DM me. Also agree pause autoscaler and disable scheduled firmware jobs.
InfraBot: incident-ops: INC-6124 created, severity=medium, assignees=[eng-infra,oncall], runbook=todo
Sam: update: canary done — ipmitool down on eth1 for 8 racks, BMC heartbeats returned, nodes started leaving AllocPending. Monitoring 10m.
Priya: nice. Next: schedule full rollback window + write runbook to prefer eth0 for mgmt + add MTU preflight in rollout pipeline.
Dmitri: I'll open runbook PR + tiny agent change to alert when eth link speed drops below 1Gbps.
Sam: filing follow-ups: PRs, cost calc, ask network team for MTU diff and switch config change logs. Thanks everyone.
